events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 801 AM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 6
miles north of Tatum, or 13 miles southwest of Marshall, moving east
at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Marshall, Hallsville, Waskom, Tatum, Beckville, Elysian Fields,
Deberry, Easton, Scottsville, Darco, Jonesville and Leigh.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM; Icy Cape to Cape Suckling from 15 to 80 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the first Gale Warning, east winds 35 to 45 kt with
gusts up to 50 kt and seas 20 to 25 ft. For the Storm Warning,
east winds 40 to 50 kt with gusts up to 55 kt and seas 22 to
27 ft expected. For the second Gale Warning, southeast winds
35 to 45 kt with gusts up to 50 kt and seas 19 to 24 ft
expected. For the Small Craft Advisory, southeast winds 20 to
30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 11 to 16 ft expected.

* WHERE...Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM and Icy Cape to
Cape Suckling from 15 to 80 NM.

* WHEN...For the first Gale Warning, until 3 PM AKST this
afternoon. For the Storm Warning, from 3 PM this afternoon to
9 PM AKST this evening. For the second Gale Warning, from 9 PM
this evening to 3 AM AKST Wednesday. For the Small Craft
Advisory, from 3 AM to 6 PM AKST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Storm force winds and hazardous seas will capsize or
damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
